planets.name: 55 Cnc d
planets.description: Planet of 55 Cnc found by radial velocity, with a 5080-day year, found in 2002.

radius.source: the NASA Exoplanet Archive's calculated radius (its Chen & Kipping 2017 mass-radius relationship): a model, not a measurement, since 55 Cnc d does not transit

mass.source: Xiao et al. (2026), Table 4: 3.23 (+0.29, -0.30) Jupiter masses, the true mass from radial velocities joined with Hipparcos and Gaia astrometry

orbit.source: Xiao et al. (2026), Table 4, a joint fit of radial velocities with Hipparcos and Gaia astrometry (the time of conjunction alone is Moutou et al. 2026, A&A 705, A190, because Xiao et al. print no epoch; a/R* is their 5.58 au over the star's recorded 656,045 km)

text.card: 55 Cnc d was found in 2002 by radial velocity; it does not cross its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 5 planets known around 55 Cnc. Its orbit, tilt included, follows Xiao et al. 2026's fit, and its size is the archive's model from its mass.
text.locator: Xiao et al. (2026), Table 4: P 5084 d, e 0.0153, omega -156.2 deg, Omega 124 deg, I 93.9 deg, M_p 3.23 M_Jup, a 5.58 au; Moutou et al. (2026), Table 3: Tconj_d 2451517.8; NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table: disc_year 2002, disc_facility Lick Observatory, sy_pnum 7, 5 of them with hostname 55 Cnc; pscomppars calculated pl_radj 1.16

quotes.title: 55 Cancri Ad
quotes.card: 55 Cancri Ad, formally named Lipperhey, is an extrasolar planet in a long-period orbit around the Sun-like star 55 Cancri A. If confirmed, it would be at a similar distance from its star as Jupiter is from the Sun, and the fifth and outermost known planet in its planetary system.
quotes.introduction: 55 Cancri Ad was discovered on June 13, 2002.
